properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The secp256k1 curve is used for ECDSA signatures in the project. While it's a widely used curve, it's vulnerable to Shor's algorithm and needs post-quantum migration.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The project contains non-constant time comparisons that could be vulnerable to timing attacks, which can leak information about secret values through timing differences.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The project references bcrypt as a key derivation function for password hashing. While bcrypt is currently secure, it will be vulnerable to quantum attacks and requires post-quantum migration.

properties.name: pqs:context

properties.name: pqs:context
